land-number: "40% faster" on the product launch reel
count-things: "12 recipes" as 12 plates that settle on the count
show-time: "ready in 15 minutes" as a kitchen timer that stops on the word
list-items: the three features of a fitness app, one per word
step-through-process: sign up, set a goal, track, share along one rail
compare: the spreadsheet done by hand against the dashboard doing it
before-after: the cluttered dashboard, then the clean one
fail-then-fix: the first upload fails red, the retry goes through green
one-to-many: one order fanning out to five delivery routes
relate-things: "synced" as an arc drawn between a phone and a watch
make-concrete: "savings" as a jar that fills coin by coin
show-real-screen: a cursor clicking through a dashboard's settings
introduce-tool: the app's name with its real logo
show-proof: the city guide's real downloads chart
reveal-headline: a section title; a full-screen claim
point-at-detail: circling the one line in the terms that matters
establish-place: the city at dusk: the skyline, the river, the lights coming on
add-depth: the product sitting on the table with a real shadow
light-the-hero: the new phone on "Meet the new model"
fill-the-backdrop: a dot grid or drifting light under a feature list
finish-the-look: stock footage and 3D renders pulled into one palette
add-impact: the beat the launch price lands
hand-over: the camera travels right along the street map to the next stop
move-camera: push in on the step that lights
keep-it-alive: a ring of recipe cards turning slowly under the title card
